scientific.integrity: The exact DIANA update closes on three second moments after centering worker shifts; the full cubic Jury criterion is proved analytically.
limitations: Half-dropout compression and canonical shift learning rate are fixed.
Local curvatures are equal although affine local-gradient heterogeneity is arbitrary with zero average.
Compression randomness is independent across workers and iterations.
Only mean-square asymptotic stability is classified.

title: Sharp worker-count stability law for DIANA with half-dropout compression
